EMBARGOED FOR RELEASE AT 8:30 A.M. EST, FRIDAY, JANUARY 29, 2010

GROSS DOMESTIC PRODUCT: FOURTH QUARTER 2009 (ADVANCE ESTIMATE)

Real gross domestic product -- the output of goods and services produced by
labor and property located in the United States -- increased at an annual rate
of 5.7 percent in the fourth quarter of 2009, according to the "advance"
estimate released by the Bureau of Economic Analysis.
